provenance.notes: Floor: pywizlight clamps dimming to DEFAULT_MIN_DIMMING = 10 % (26 of 255) for bulbs that do not report their own minDimLevel. Some models report a different minimum; give them their own profile. Sub-floor: Home Assistant passes rgb/rgbw channels unchanged to the bulb, so weak channels at the floor brightness can go below it. How far below depends on the model and is not measured here.
